bus_get_tour_detail.description:
Fetch detailed information, schedule, pricing, and bus stops for a specific Maitabi mountain bus tour by course_no.

Returns the detail object for a single course_no (itinerary, bus stops, seat options, pricing, lodging), or the batch envelope with page: null when course_no is a list; an item in that list can carry its own error.

course_no.description: Internal course number(s) on bus.maitabi.jp, copied from a bus_search_tours result (e.g., 14241, 8518). Can be a single int or list of ints for batch fetching.

bus_get_tour_detail.title: Maitabi: bus tour detail

bus_list_district_groups.description:
Fetch mountain district groups and their tour counts for Maitabi mountain bus tours.

These group IDs are display buckets, not the search `area` filter: discover `area` IDs with bus_list_filter_master(kind='district'). Supports cascading filtering—groups and counts update dynamically based on other selected filters.

area.description: Destination district ID (e.g., 13=Shin-Hotaka Onsen, 10=Kamikochi, 18=Tateyama Murodo, 0=All). Discover IDs with bus_list_filter_master(kind='district').

anyOf.description: Bus seat configuration ID for mountain bus tours.

bus_sheet.description: Bus seat type: 1=Standard, 2=Premium, 3=Outbound Premium / Inbound Standard, 4=Outbound Standard / Inbound Premium, 5=Double seat, 6=Taxi

course_cd.description: Deprecated: upstream matches nothing for this filter (always 0 results). Use keyword instead. Example code: 'S104C21'.

keyword.description: Search keyword in Japanese (e.g., '立山', '上高地')

month.description: Departure month (1-12). Defaults to current month if omitted.

anyOf.description: Return date option ID for mountain bus tours relative to departure.

return_day.description: Return date option: 1=1 day after departure, 2=2 days after, 3=3 days after, 4=4 days after, 5=5 days after

stay1.description: Mountain lodge ID for night 1 (e.g., 5=Enzanso, 2=Nishiho Sanso). Discover IDs with bus_list_filters (lodges).

stay2.description: Mountain lodge ID for night 2 (see bus_list_filters for IDs)

stay3.description: Mountain lodge ID for night 3 (see bus_list_filters for IDs)

anyOf.description: Tour style ID for mountain bus tours.

style.description: Tour style: 1=Round-trip bus, 2=Outbound bus, 3=Inbound bus, 4=Round-trip lodge, 5=Outbound lodge, 6=Overnight day-trip, 7=Taxi plan

bus_list_filter_master.description:
Fetch one cascading master list for mountain bus tours: tour styles, bus seat types, return-day options, or area/district groups.

Same data as bus_list_filters but one group at a time, with a much smaller payload. Counts stay filter-aware: they reflect the other filters passed in, so ids with tour_count 0 are unavailable for that combination.

bus_list_filters.description:
Fetch available filter dropdown options, departure areas, tour styles, mountain lodges, and tour counts for Maitabi bus tours.

bus_search_tours.description:
Search mountain bus tours and lodge packages on Maitabi (bus.maitabi.jp) with detailed filter criteria.

Returns the search envelope: count (upstream total, before the price and availability filters), page, items with course_no, title, date, price in JPY, status and detail_url, and the query actually sent. Pass course_no to bus_get_tour_detail for the itinerary.

area.description: Destination district ID (e.g., 13=Shin-Hotaka Onsen, 10=Kamikochi, 18=Tateyama Murodo, 0=All). Discover IDs with bus_list_filter_master(kind='district').

anyOf.description: Bus seat configuration ID for mountain bus tours.

keyword.description: Search keyword in Japanese (e.g., '立山', '上高地')

max_price.description: Maximum price in JPY (e.g., 20000). Filters the results before returning.

min_price.description: Minimum price in JPY (e.g., 10000). Filters the results before returning.

general_get_calendar.description:
Fetch monthly departure calendar and tour schedule matrix on www.maitabi.jp for a given year and month.

Returns the daily departure matrix with tour availability. Use it to see which days have departures before searching a range; narrow with travel_type because the full matrix is large. Capped at 60 requests/min per IP.

anyOf.description: Category ID for Maitabi general tours (www.maitabi.jp).

travel_type.description: Optional category ID filter: 1=Domestic Mountain, 2=Domestic Travel, 3=Mountain Bus, 4=Overseas Mountain, 5=Overseas Travel

general_get_calendar.title: Maitabi: monthly departure calendar

general_get_tour_detail.description:
Fetch the full page for one general tour on www.maitabi.jp: day-by-day itinerary, travel conditions (minimum participants, tour conductor, meals), every departure date with price and booking status, the full description, and the booking link.

www.maitabi.jp publishes no detail API, so this reads the rendered detail page: the tour record comes from the page's embedded JSON and the three tables from its markup. One object per single course_no, an envelope for a list. Capped at 60 requests/min per IP.

course_no.description: Tour course number(s) on www.maitabi.jp, copied from a general_search_tours result (e.g., 1723, 24865). Can be a single int or list of ints for batch fetching.

general_get_tour_detail.title: Maitabi: general tour detail

general_search_tours.description:
Search general travel tours and mountain climbing packages on www.maitabi.jp.

Returns the search envelope: count (upstream total), page, items with course_no, title, date, price in JPY, a numeric status (1/2 bookable, 3 closed) and detail_url, plus the query actually sent. Capped at 60 requests/min per IP.

category_nos1.description: Subcategory Nos for Style/Duration (e.g. [36] for Day trip, [259] for Overnight)

category_nos2.description: Subcategory Nos for Difficulty/Shoes (e.g. [363] for Grade 1 / Introduction)

category_nos3.description: Subcategory Nos for Departure Region (e.g. [13] for Kanto, [15] for Tokai)

day.description: Departure day of month (1-31). Can be a single int, a list of ints, or a string range (e.g., '14-16, 20').

keyword.description: Search keyword in Japanese (e.g., '富士山', '京都')

list_order.description: Sort order: 'startDateAsc' (departure earliest), 'saikouStatus' (departure status), 'yoyakuStatus' (availability), 'priceAsc' (price low to high), 'priceDesc' (price high to low)

max_price.description: Maximum price in JPY (e.g., 50000). Filters the results before returning.

min_price.description: Minimum price in JPY (e.g., 10000). Filters the results before returning.

require_available_seats.description: If True, filters out full/closed tours (満席, 受付終了).

travel_type.description: Category ID: 1=Domestic Mountain (default), 2=Domestic Travel, 3=Mountain Bus, 4=Overseas Mountain, 5=Overseas Travel

general_search_tours.title: Maitabi: search general tours
